title: Infrared iBERA liquid-staking token (Berachain) — verified impl, every value path gated; E-U $0
closed_reasons: 0x9b6761bf2397Bb5a6624a856cC84A3A14Dcd3fe5 is the iBERA liquid-staking TOKEN (name 'Infrared BERA', symbol iBERA), not a deposit vault; its native BERA balance is 0 and the $14.2M backing is staked on the Berachain CL via the Depositor/Withdrawor.

The implementation 0xC0654903c7d76F7FE63f9AD2F01618c3B55D9DcF IS Etherscan-verified (InfraredBERAV2_1, exact match, SimilarMatch='') and is proven BYTE-EXACTLY equal to the public source github.com/infrared-dao/contracts src/staking/InfraredBERAV2_1.sol (recompiled with solc 0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a, runs 50, cancun, library 0x49b696528cf0979ed8b13c1e32a9e54f09285416, 3 UUPS immutables filled). The pass-4 'unverified implementation' residual is removed.

mint(address) payable is permissionless but fully backed by msg.value: shares = (totalSupply*amount)/deposits floored, compound() runs BEFORE the price is read, and mint with 0 value reverts InvalidShares(). No unbacked mint exists.
burn(address,uint256) is self-scoped: it burns msg.sender's own iBERA and reverts ERC20InsufficientBalance for a caller with no balance; the receiver may not be the depositor.

All admin setters (setWithdrawalsEnabled/updateBurnFee/updateRateProvider/setFeeDivisorShareholders/updateProofTimestampBuffer/setDepositSignature/claimExitFees/unpause/upgradeToAndCall) revert AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(caller, GOVERNANCE_ROLE) from a fresh address.
grantRole/revokeRole revert AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount; pause() reverts NotPauser(); collect()/sweep()/register() revert Unauthorized(caller); registerViaProofs is onlyKeeper.
The deployed revision has NO initialize() at all (proxy and impl both revert with empty data), so there is no re-initialization / role-grant takeover.

Governance is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 (0x182a31A27A0D39d735b31e80534CFE1fCd92c38f) holding DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE + GOVERNANCE_ROLE; PAUSER_ROLE has no holder; KEEPER_ROLE = 1 Safe-style contract + 1 EOA.

The InfraredV2 core 0xb71b3DaEA39012Fb0f2B14D2a9C86da9292fC126 (0.0099 BERA) re-probed from a fresh address: redeemIbgtForBera = onlyKeeper, claimExternalVaultRewards = Unauthorized, setters/upgradeToAndCall = onlyGovernor.

Latent (not extractable today): Receivor.sweep() has no auth check (benign - pays the caller nothing, mints to the gated collect() path); mint() is not whenNotPaused; previewBurn() waives the fee for msg.sender==rateProvider while burn() does not.
Trust assumption: the 3-of-6 Safe can upgradeToAndCall to arbitrary code - the $14.2M is P-class by construction, not attacker-reachable.
Not attempted: CL-side validator accounting reconciliation; decompilation of the other pass-4 unverified impls (Kuru).
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the Infrared iBERA LST ($14.2M TVL on Berachain): the target is the iBERA token (not a deposit vault), its implementation is Etherscan-verified and proven byte-identical to the public source, and every value path is governance-gated (AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount(_, GOVERNANCE_ROLE)), keeper-gated, fixed-caller-gated, or self-scoped (mint needs msg.value; burn burns the caller's own iBERA) - fork-verified 16/16.
